correctness.rationale: The model is defined on all a,cu,cr,B>0 with u,v>=0 and budget 2cu u+cr v=B. The positive Perron root is the unique positive zero of lambda^3-2au lambda-a^2v, including zero-link endpoints. Evaluating its reduced polynomial at lambda0=a cu/cr gives a2(B0-B)/cr; comparing two positive roots at distinct u proves strict crossover and all critical ties. Explicit endpoint equations give maximum/minimum and the inverse target-budget expression. Actual packaged verifier passed 13,440 exact determinant and 2,688 exact anchor checks, 384 sampled monotonicity/endpoint cases, 845 threshold cases and exact example; finite checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: The minimal closed directed three-patch layout has both two-step reciprocal and three-step shortcut return circuits. A common restoration budget forces a concrete policy choice with a mathematically sharp and direction-reversing optimum, plus a nontrivial whole-segment neutrality boundary and an exact resource threshold for a desired linear growth rate. It is neither a random numerical slice nor a known-table calculation; the conclusion is appropriately limited to a finite structured system.
